page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance configured for high-capacity data processing and memory-intensive enterprise applications. Built on the x86_64 architecture and running under the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz.

The server delivers a massive memory footprint of 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of memory per core. Network performance is backed by a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. It features zero GPU accelerators and provides no bundled local disk storage, requiring external network-attached storage options for persistent data retention.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance offers high memory density to handle large working sets in memory without context-switching delays. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network volumes, which introduces performance dependency on storage throughput. Cost efficiency is driven by its high ratio of memory per vCPU, enabling heavy database and caching footprints on a single virtual server without purchasing extra vCPU resources.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is best suited for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases like Redis or Memcached, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, distributed data analytics, real-time stream processing, and high-capacity transactional database systems.
